source_validation: Resolve immutable official URLs/commits and compare selected file digests to recorded Git objects; read relevant implementation and actual lockfile resolutions. Preserve failures and uncertainty. Do not regenerate cryptographic expectations or run product tests merely to assert documentation exists.
final_review: Reviewer distinct from /root, exact final commit and all output hashes; changed source or content requires affected review.
integration: Coordinator-owned reviewed post-A02 layout/graph reconciliation and normal PR CI; frozen historical P01 artifacts remain byte-exact.
unperformed: No client/browser/device interaction, optical measurement, recovery drill, human pilot, Board example execution, release qualification or market validation is claimed by this task.
